name: Potatoom 3
author: Rinnegatamante
description:
Potatoom 3 is a PoC level port of Doom 3, popular FPS made by idSoftware with idTech 4 engine.
This port is based over a modified version of dhewm3 that adds basic multithreading support to idTech 4 optimized furtherly to squeeze as much performances as possible.
